bluf: The Guardian World reported that millions joined Spain’s first general strike in 14 years to protest housing prices, less than three weeks before parliamentary elections. BleepingComputer reported that CISA warned a Cisco BroadWorks vulnerability was being exploited in attacks.

changes.text: Updated since previous brief: CISA flags WordPress RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks

cyber.text: BleepingComputer reported that CISA warned hackers were exploiting a high-severity Cisco BroadWorks vulnerability in attacks.
The Record reported that Microsoft’s latest Patch Tuesday listed 1,093 bugs and that an exploited Outlook vulnerability drew most of the attention.

items.text: France 24 reported that Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei said Tehran would attack US bases in Europe if they were used for bombing raids against Iran.
The Guardian World reported that millions joined the general strike in Spain to protest housing prices; BBC News World said protests were expected in major cities ahead of parliamentary elections.
